title: Don't Be a Stranger
content: Meaning/Usage: Commonly used to tell someone to stay in touch Explanation: This is commonly used when you are talking to someone you don't meet or see often. "It was really nice seeing you again. Don't be a stranger." "We need to keep in touch. Don't be a stranger." "Now that we live so close to one another don't be a stranger." A. "Hey John, I don't see you around here these days." B. "I moved down south several months ago." A. "Keep in touch man. Don't be a stranger." B. "Definitely. I'll buzz you every time I come up." Other Common Sentences "Keep in touch." "Ping me once in awhile."
